title: Sisaala language - Wikipedia
text: Sisaala is a Gur language cluster spoken in northern Ghana near the town of Tumu and in the neighbouring republic of Burkina Faso. Western Sisaala is intermediate between Sisaali and Tumulung Sisaala.

text: Paasaal is a stable indigenous language of Ghana. It belongs to the Niger-Congo language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.

title: Paasaal language and alphabet
text: Paasaal is also known as Pasaale Sisaala or Southern Sisaala. There are two dialects: Gilbagala and Pasaali. It is closely related to Western Sisaala and Tumulung Sisaala, which are also spoken in northern Ghana, and Sisaali, which is spoken in Burkina Faso.
